q: What year did E.T. come out in theaters?
explain: 1982! It is right at the top of your fact sheet.

q: How many Oscars did E.T. win?
explain: Four: for its music, its sound, its sound effects and its visual effects. It is on your fact sheet.

q: Who teaches E.T. to talk, with a little help from Sesame Street?
explain: Gertie. She dresses him up, sits him in front of the TV, and gets him saying his first words.

items: Elliott leaves a trail of Reese's Pieces
E.T. builds a phone out of a Speak & Spell
E.T. gets sick and the agents take over the house
The bikes fly over the police roadblock
explain: Candy trail, then the phone, then the sickness, then the flying bikes on the way to the ship.

q: At the end of the movie, E.T. decides to stay on Earth with Elliott.
explain: False. E.T. goes home with his family, but first he tells Elliott: I'll be right here.
Here. E.T. touches his glowing finger to Elliott's forehead when he says it.

q: What candy does Elliott use to lead E.T. into his house?
explain: A trail of Reese's Pieces. Real-life sales of the candy exploded after the movie.

q: Elliott and E.T. share feelings. What does Elliott do at school that proves it?
options: He sets all the frogs free in science class
He falls asleep at his desk
explain: While E.T. gets into trouble at home, Elliott goes wild at school and frees every frog in class.

q: How does Elliott know E.T. is alive again?
options: The wilted flowers bloom again and his heart-light glows
explain: The dying flowers spring back to life, and E.T.'s chest glows red. He got the message: his family is coming!

q: Tap E.T.'s glowing finger, the one that heals.
explain: The healing finger. It fixes Elliott's cut, brings the flowers back, and says goodbye.
